title: ViD: Vision-Dominant Gender Bias Mitigation for Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model-generated text using keyword matching to extract gender-specific terms, and subsequently calculating a bias score and log gender ratio across multiple benchmark datasets (FACET, MS COCO, FairFace). The methodology also includes intersectional multi-attribute gender bias assessments by evaluating performance across various combinations of occupations, skin tones, and hairstyles.
